csv_agency: State of VT Div for Historic Preservation
csv_scope_of_work: This project consists of exhibit design, fabrication, and delivery of finished products to the Calvin Coolidge State Historic Site located at 3780 VT Route 100A, Plymouth, VT 05056. The primary responsibility of the Vendor is to execute the vision of the Coolidge Site Staff by designing an exhibit panel for a new permanent installation. All content, both interpretive text and historic photographs, have been curated by Site Staff, and the Vendor is not expected to complete any research or historic interpretation.
